g.text: Pooled versus mode-conditional q50 cutoffs: midpoint error
All event kinds. Outside: observed midpoint norm >.10 m. Grey NA: empty retained set or unavailable fit.
Known seeds alone fit both shared-arm rules; modes retain the original parent case weights. Tied ticks stay together.
Both cohorts were observed previously. A conditional fitting quantile does not calibrate evaluation coverage or error risk.
